stats.text:
You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or {ref:glossary/long-rest}, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

***Colossus Slayer.*** Your tenacity can wear down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage to the target if it's missing any of its {ref:glossary/hit-points}. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

***Horde Breaker.*** Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon's range, and that you haven't attacked this turn.
